treatments.title: IVF Treatment
treatments.summary: Advanced fertility treatment where eggs and sperm are combined outside the body.
treatments.content: IVF is an advanced fertility treatment where eggs and sperm are combined outside the body, and the resulting embryo is transferred into the uterus.

treatments.title: IUI Treatment
treatments.summary: Prepared sperm is placed directly inside the uterus around the time of ovulation.
treatments.content: IUI is a fertility treatment where prepared sperm is placed directly inside the uterus around the time of ovulation.

blogs.title: Reports Normal, Still Not Pregnant?
blogs.excerpt: Understanding why pregnancy might not happen even when basic tests are normal.
blogs.content: Sometimes basic fertility tests appear normal, leaving couples confused. This is often called unexplained infertility. A fertility specialist can guide you through advanced evaluations to find the root cause.

testimonials.name: Anonymous Patient
testimonials.text: Dr. Rakhi Goyal was incredibly supportive throughout our journey. Her guidance was clear and kind.

faqs.question: When should a couple consult a fertility specialist?
faqs.answer: A couple should consider consultation if pregnancy has not happened after regular trying for 12 months, or after 6 months if the female partner is above 35.

faqs.question: Is IVF the only option for infertility?
faqs.answer: No. Treatment depends on the cause. Some couples may need medicines, lifestyle guidance, IUI, IVF, or further evaluation.
